# Contributing to Terrakube CLI

Thank you for your interest in contributing to `terrakube-cli`! This document outlines the guidelines for submitting bug reports, feature requests, code modifications, and adding new CLI subcommands.

---

## Code of Conduct

We expect all contributors to adhere to standard open-source community standards. Be respectful, inclusive, and collaborative.

---

## How to Contribute

### 1. Reporting Issues

Before opening a new issue, please search existing issues to see if it has already been reported. When filing an issue, include:
- A clear, descriptive title.
- Steps to reproduce the bug.
- Expected behavior vs. actual behavior.
- Terrakube CLI version (`terrakube --version`) and OS environment details.

### 2. Development Workflow

1. **Fork & Clone**: Fork the repository on GitHub and clone it locally.
2. **Create a Feature Branch**:
   ```bash
   git checkout -b feature/my-new-feature
   ```
3. **Make Code Changes**: Requires Go 1.26. `mise install` sets up the pinned Go, golangci-lint, govulncheck, and gofumpt versions from `mise.toml`.
4. **Run Formatters & Linters**: Code is formatted with gofumpt (configured in `.golangci.yml`).
   ```bash
   golangci-lint fmt ./...
   golangci-lint run ./...
   ```
5. **Run Tests**:
   ```bash
   go test -race ./...
   ```
   `mise run check` runs build, tests, lint, and govulncheck together.
6. **Commit Changes**: Follow clear commit message conventions.
7. **Submit a Pull Request**: Push your branch to GitHub and submit a PR against the `main` branch.

---

## CLI Architecture & Resource Framework

Resource commands are generated by `resource.Register[T]()` from `internal/resource`. Avoid writing hand-written Cobra subcommands for CRUD resources.

### Registering a New Resource

Create `cmd/<resource>.go` with an `init()` that registers the resource against a type from [terrakube-go](https://github.com/terrakube-io/terrakube-go). Only the API closures you provide get a subcommand (`list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `delete`). Trimmed from `cmd/template.go`:

```go
package cmd

import (
	"context"

	terrakube "github.com/terrakube-io/terrakube-go"

	"terrakube/internal/resource"
)

func init() {
	resource.Register(rootCmd, resource.Config[terrakube.Template]{
		Runtime: resource.Runtime{
			NewClient:  newClient,
			GetContext: getContext,
			GetOutput:  func() string { return output },
		},
		Name:    "template",
		Aliases: []string{"tpl", "templates"},
		Parents: []resource.ParentScope{{
			Name:      "organization",
			Flag:      "organization",
			ShortFlag: "o",
			Aliases:   []string{"org"},
			IDFlag:    "organization-id",
			Resolver:  orgResolver, // cmd/resolvers.go
		}},
		Fields: []resource.FieldDef{
			{StructField: "Name", Flag: "name", Short: "n", Type: resource.String, Required: true, Description: "Template name"},
			{StructField: "Content", Flag: "content", Short: "c", Type: resource.String, Required: true, Description: "Template content (HCL)"},
		},
		List: func(ctx context.Context, c *terrakube.Client, pIDs []string, opts *terrakube.ListOptions) ([]*terrakube.Template, error) {
			return c.Templates.List(ctx, pIDs[0], opts)
		},
		Get: func(ctx context.Context, c *terrakube.Client, pIDs []string, id string) (*terrakube.Template, error) {
			return c.Templates.Get(ctx, pIDs[0], id)
		},
	})
}
```

Parent flags accept a UUID or a name; names are resolved through the `Resolver`. Add new resolvers to `cmd/resolvers.go` using `resolveByName` and `nameFilter`. Do not name a field flag `output`, since `--output` is the global format flag.

## Running End-to-End Tests

Integration tests use [BATS](https://github.com/bats-core/bats-core).

To run the end-to-end test suite locally:

1. Ensure a local test server instance is running (e.g. `https://terrakube-api.platform.local`).
2. Export your credentials (the suite runs `terrakube login` with them against a temporary `HOME`, so your own `~/.terrakube-cli.yaml` is not modified):
   ```bash
   export TERRAKUBE_API_URL="https://terrakube-api.platform.local"
   export TERRAKUBE_PAT="XXXXXXXXXXXXX" # Terrakube Admin Personal Access Token
   ```
3. Execute the tests:
   ```bash
   bats tests/e2e_operations.bats
   ```
